why: Multiple searches confirm B(2,5) finiteness is still explicitly stated as open in 2025 sources (Euler Circle paper, Groupprops, Cambridge Bulletin article on RB(2,5)). Found progress on other exponents (Atkarskaya-Rips-Tent: B(r,n) infinite for odd n>557, 2024) but that does not cover n=5 and is a different case of the general problem, not this one.
